args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production
args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address the unhealthy v2.3.1 release (18% error rate). Change approved by change-manager. Recording the change per runbook.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Verified current state**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all regions, which was unhealthy (18% error rate). Prior healthy versions were v2.2.9 and v2.3.0.

2. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The deploy was routed for human approval since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, and the change-manager approved it.

3. **Opened SEV3 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api recording the change, which paged the on-call engineer.

4. **Verified the result**: checkout-api is now on v2.3.2 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate down to 0.2% (from 18%).
